# MODEL: Two-agent fuzzyCGS with 4 states (s0-s3)

# PURPOSE: ATLF on labels between 0 and 1.

# LOGIC: ATLF

# DESCRIPTION: In s0 agent 1 has only action A and agent 2 picks C (to s1) or
# D (to s2); in s1 agent 1 has only B and agent 2 picks C (stay) or D (to s3);
# s2 and s3 loop. p has value 0 in s0, 0.2 in s1, 0.7 in s2 and 0.4 in s3.

Transition
0 AC AD 0
0 BC 0 BD
0 0 * 0
0 0 0 *
Name_State
s0 s1 s2 s3
Initial_State
s0
Atomic_propositions
p
Labelling
0
0.2
0.7
0.4
Number_of_agents
2
